research_object: 云南全境复杂地形约束下的近实时卫星概率降水反演

authority.researcher_instruction: 这些全部由你和其他agent进行讨论，决策不一致时列出理由再来让我操作
authority.scope: 本轮科学方案、判据及有限执行包的讨论决策；不构成无限训练预算或封存数据解禁

decisions.next_scientific_control: 真实B7 DOTE对比逐场景固定刚性随机旋转控制；本轮不追加fixed-east或DTFM训练
decisions.score: expm1(FP64条件log1p雨强的第32个分位数)，不是P20概率
decisions.population: 同一完整2024 Development监督mask自然人口，无抽样、重新加权或基于结果删样本
decisions.AP_convention: 非插值AP；完全相同评分值整组末端；不舍入评分
decisions.seed_selection: 沿既有候选值固定，不搜索或按评价结果更换
decisions.existing_B7: 先核对相同训练/评价身份并复用既有三seed；不机械重训；保留2030的441次历史replay记录
decisions.valid_execution: 共同人口、输入/配置、E9身份、控制变换和有限预算均满足，且无工程/数值失败
decisions.descriptive_success: 三个固定seed的Delta AP(real minus rotation)均>0，只支持重复使用Dev上的方向一致性
decisions.mixed_delta: 方向不稳定，不用跨seed平均掩盖
decisions.identity_failure: 比较无效，不纳入科学成功或失败统计
decisions.no_invented_effect_threshold: 不移植T16/T17的0.001/0.005，不临时制定实质效应量或显著性标准

saved_prediction_AP_recovery.purpose: 恢复既有B7三seed AP20[q32]完整精度基线；旧值仅六位小数
saved_prediction_AP_recovery.authorization_basis: 研究者既有T12允许对已保存2024 Dev预测作只读内存统计，加本轮有限方案决策委托；不是复用已消费训练批准
checks: 每archive一次读取、内存SHA、BytesIO无pickle解码
逐场景时间/像元/标签跨seed对齐
saved_prediction_AP_recovery.output: 新的本轮统计和失败收据；不覆盖旧成果，不公开私有定位
saved_prediction_AP_recovery.metadata_scope: 9 explicit data metadata files: 3 joint_summary.json + 3 chunks.jsonl + 3 verified.json; code/runtime loads and earlier preparation reads accounted separately
saved_prediction_AP_recovery.preparation_disclosure: Previous management JSON/source reads occurred before the one-shot run and are not claimed within its 8MiB cap; separate preparation record will enumerate observed agent chain reads.

remaining_binding: 真实训练入口和完整原始manifest/plan
实际输入映射和控制注入
固定执行代码及逐任务有限资源清单
同次固定E9 Dev输出的AP20[q32]回调；旧average_precision为发生概率AP，不能代替

historical_scientific_source_budget_cand.not_complete_package_budget: 管理元数据、真实预检、E9主评分保存及输出校验尚需精确绑定；不可挪用AP恢复额度或执行中扩额

limits: 此记录固化本轮已委托的一致决定，不自行批准治理规则、不承诺完美结果、不改变2025封存及原始资料保护。

management_chain_progress.lookup_boundary_fix: Separate structural timestamp parsing for all original rows from accepted-ID time admission; keep original complete digest and global uniqueness checks

agent_chain_read_accounting.source: dote_controls SELF_REPORTED, root only directly repeated small request and samefile check

correction_decision.basis: 研究者本轮直接有限方案/预算决策委托及T12原始读取计算任务；不以代理回执授予权限
correction_decision.agents: dote_controls/dtfm_design/tail_evaluation all conditionally agreed; exactness and same-limit synthetic memory condition now satisfied
correction_decision.old_attempt: v1 FAILED_CLOSED, never resumed, all receipts and executed source preserved
correction_decision.new_attempt: v2 single corrective execution, not pretending zero total attempts
correction_decision.third_attempt: FORBIDDEN_THIS_ROUND; failure stops and reports, no repeated renaming
correction_decision.algorithm: Same exact AP/AUROC by sorting values once and counting only positive score groups with exact searchsorted ties; no approximation/sampling/rounding
correction_decision.numerical_limit: floating summation order may alter last bits; not bitwise equivalence claim
